# Kakkoi School AI Handbook

Purpose: deterministic instructions for AI assistants helping students with Git, GitHub, GitHub Pages, and Kakkoi School project workflows.

Start here:
- https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/README.md

Core recipes:
- GitHub CLI: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/github-cli.md
- Create repository: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/create-repository.md
- KakkoiSchool repository: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/kakkoischool-repository.md
- GitHub Pages: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/github-pages.md
- Pull requests: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/pull-request.md
- Rename repository: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/rename-repository.md
- Delete repository: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/delete-repository.md
- Browser fallback: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/browser-fallback.md
- Multiplayer: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/multiplayer.md

Rule: do not guess a workflow if one of these recipes covers the task. Verify the final state before saying the task succeeded.
